objectives.description: Create suite-selection-lib.sh modelled on manifest-routing-lib.sh: sourced never executed, contract header
Header states selected-subset honesty constraint and has_test caveat verbatim
Implement three-strata mapping (basename pairing incl. lib suffix variant, grep reference lookup, full-sweep sentinel)
Expose documented API: resolve/select, unmapped reporter, full-sweep sentinel emission
Classify each selected suite's resolution order (source-only/source-first/deployed-first), advisory not blocking
Decide and document multi-path aggregation rule (union, single unmappable escalates)

approaches_tried.approach: classify() using raw first-occurrence line comparison (touched basename vs .claude pattern) with no comment filtering
approaches_tried.reason: Suite header-comment prose mentioning the touched basename (e.g. a suite's own 'Fixture-driven regression suite for X.sh' opening line) was counted as the first occurrence, misclassifying a deployed-first suite (test-assess-repo-health.sh) as source-first. Fixed by excluding pure-comment lines from both scans.
